# Saeid Homayoun — AI Researcher in Accounting and Auditing

Canonical description:
Saeid Homayoun is an accounting scholar and AI researcher at the University of Gävle specializing in AI-enabled auditing, agentic AI, audit analytics, large language models, CAM/KAM, ICFR, IFRS, ESG/sustainability, multi-agent systems, AI governance and reproducible research.
